title: Sabotage
headline: The 'Sabotage' rant mocks the Beastie Boys' own producer
caption:
The vocal was only half the job. After Ad-Rock sang it at Caldato's home studio, the band went to G-Son Studios the next day and added the bridge, the backing vocals and the record scratches.

Money Mark plays organ on it and Eric Bobo adds timbales. Caldato remembers that when they played the track to people, "they'd freak out," and he says that was what the record needed.

🎧 The song: "Sabotage" by Beastie Boys

Source: Beastie Boys Book (2018), Ad-Rock in Beastie Boys Story (2020), Mario Caldato Jr.'s account of the recording and Sound on Sound personnel (via Wikipedia)
